title: Impact of Plunge in Crude Oil Rates on Retail Prices at Petrol Pumps
what_it_is: Impact of Plunge in Crude Oil Rates on Retail Prices at Petrol Pumps

sections.label: Brent crude and petrol pass-through
sections.summary: Between 2 January and 9 March 2020 Brent crude fell from US$66 to US$34 per barrel, and Octane 95 petrol fell 20 cents per litre with a six-day lag.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan Wu Meng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Between 2 January 2020 and 9 March 2020, the Brent crude price fell from US$66 to US$34 per barrel.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan Wu Meng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: If this price decrease was fully passed through, or in other words, mirrored in retail petrol prices, then retail petrol prices would have dropped by 26 Singapore cents per litre.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan Wu Meng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The listed price of Octane 95 petrol fell by 20 cents per litre, with a slight lag of six days.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan Wu Meng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This represents a pass-through of over three-quarters of the decrease in crude oil price.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan Wu Meng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Based on an in-depth study on retail petrol prices conducted by the then-Competition Commission of Singapore in 2017, a pass-through of around 70% for both price increases and decreases is typical.

sections.label: CASE Fuel Kaki website
sections.summary: The Consumers Association of Singapore launched Fuel Kaki, a retail petrol price comparison website, to help empower consumers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan Wu Meng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To help empower consumers, the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) has launched Fuel Kaki, a retail petrol price comparison website.

sections.label: CCS research on pass-through
sections.summary: Research by the then-Competition Commission of Singapore found the pass-through of an oil price increase and decrease is about the same.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: If we look at the research that was done by the then-CCS, what they found was that the pass-through of an increase in the price of oil – and when you compare the increase with the decrease, the pass-through is about the same.

sections.label: Timing of petrol pass-through
sections.summary: Prices take longer to go up on average for roughly the same pass-through, while the pass-through happens more quickly when oil prices go down.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: So, the prices take longer to go up on average for roughly the same pass-through, whereas when the price goes down for oil, the pass-through happens a bit more quickly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: So, in summary, basically it takes longer for the pass-through on the upward side, but it is faster when it happens on the downward side.
